proposed_widenings.name: save_gate_on_magic_action
proposed_widenings.justification: Telekinesis's per-turn effect is a save_gate (STR) opened by the caster spending their Magic action — a repeatable within-concentration activation cost not expressible via roll_modifier or damage_on_hit
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you cast the spell and as a Magic action on your later turns before the spell ends, you can exert your will on one creature or object

proposed_widenings.name: force_move
proposed_widenings.justification: The primary effect of a successful telekinesis save failure is moving the target up to 30 feet in any direction. The spell Effect union (DamageEffect | NoneEffect) has no force_move variant, even though v4 taxonomy lists force_move as an effect atom
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or you move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range

proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition (spell Effect context)
proposed_widenings.justification: The creature branch applies the Restrained condition on save failure. apply_condition exists in mastery SaveGateRiderResult but is absent from the spell Effect union used in ActivationPhase and ongoing operation effects
proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the end of your next turn, the creature has the Restrained condition

proposed_widenings.name: restrained (Condition type)
proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type is narrowed to 'prone' only. Telekinesis inflicts Restrained, requiring the Condition union to be widened
proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature has the Restrained condition, and if you lift it into the air, it is suspended there

proposed_widenings.name: object (Attachment kind)
proposed_widenings.justification: The object manipulation modes target an object rather than a creature. v4 taxonomy lists 'object' as an attachment atom but it is absent from the Attachment union in types.ts
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can try to move a Huge or smaller object. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet

proposed_widenings.name: activation_cost field on OngoingOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: Each invocation of the telekinesis effect consumes the caster's Magic action (beyond concentration maintenance). OngoingEffectMechanics has no way to express a per-invocation action cost within the ongoing operation
proposed_widenings.evidence: as a Magic action on your later turns before the spell ends, you can exert your will on one creature or object

notes: The ongoing_effect family is conceptually correct — Telekinesis is a concentration spell that grants a repeating per-turn effect. The gaps are entirely in the surface vocabulary: OngoingOperation is too narrow (only roll_modifier/damage_on_hit), the spell Effect union lacks force_move and apply_condition, Condition lacks 'restrained', Attachment lacks 'object', and there is no per-invocation action cost field on OngoingOperation. The dual creature/object mode branching is an additional representability gap. Object fine-control (manipulate tools, open containers) is narrative and plausibly dm_agenda for this sub-mode only.
